findings: On the 66 matched lines, the FY2026 request totals $5,324.1M, up $1,013.8M (+23.5%) from $4,310.3M enacted in FY2025.
Collaborative Combat Aircraft account for $862.4M of the FY2026 request across 3 lines. Without CCA the matched total is $4,461.7M, up $863.2M (+24.0%).
Counter-drone (C-UAS) lines total $981.0M in FY2026 against $744.4M in FY2025 (+31.8%), before counting any share of mixed air-defence lines such as M-SHORAD.
$1,320.9M of the FY2026 figure (24.8%) is in the separate reconciliation request rather than the base discretionary request.

15 lines are new in FY2026 ($2,265.3M) and 15 lines with FY2025 money have no FY2026 request ($1,397.9M); the largest new one is Army Small Unmanned Aerial Systems (P-1 7000I47000, $726.0M). Some titles appear in both groups under different codes, so read single-line changes with care; the totals do not depend on codes.
